STARLINK: JAPAN COAST GUARD GETS WIRED UP
Starlink flipped the switch for the Japan Coast Guard—high-speed internet on the high seas!
All 12 large patrol ships are now online, keeping crews connected 24/7—a savvy move to lure young talent.
•⁠  ⁠NETWORK JOLT — Starlink powers up 12 JCG ships with zippy internet.
•⁠  ⁠CREW PERK — Smartphones online even off-duty, banishing sea stress.
•⁠  ⁠FUTURE ROLL — 85 more ships will join the Starlink party by 2032.
Starlink’s internet beams will keep JCG crews sharp and connected on every mission!
Source: Nippon․com


Mario Nawfal: 🇧🇩 STARLINK HITS BANGLADESH—THE SKY JUST GOT WIRED
Bangladesh is now plugged into space. 
Starlink’s high-speed, low-latency internet has officially landed, beaming broadband straight from orbit. 
No waiting. 
Just blazing-fast access, even in places fiber forgot.
